text: . Лонидамин C15H10Cl2N2O2 = 321.2. CAS — 50264-69-2. ATC — L01XX07. ATC Vet — QL01XX07. Profile Lonidamine is an antineoplastic that is thought to act by inhibit- ing mitochondrial function in tumour cells. It has been given orally in the treatment of various solid neoplasms, including those of the lung, breast, prostate, and brain. Profile Mafosfamide is a derivative of cyclophosphamide (p.702) that has been used to treat bone marrow for transplantation. It is also under investigation in the treatment of neoplastic meningitis.
